name: pmg-run-the-retro
description: Runs a team retro that checks last retro's action first, picks a format for this cycle's question, groups the team's input into themes, and ends in one change the team controls with one owner and a check date, plus an escalation list. Use for "run pmg-run-the-retro", "plan our retro", "sprint retrospective", "retro format", "4Ls retro", "start stop continue", "our retro actions never happen", "write up the retro", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
